t: The Karcher K3 eco!Booster home pressure washer is an electric pressure washer built for efficient outdoor cleaning. Delivering up to 120 bar from a 1.6kW air-cooled motor, it suits patios, garden furniture and small hardstanding. The eco!Booster lance improves cleaning efficiency on delicate surfaces, while the Dirt Blaster tackles stubborn grime. A home kit with surface cleaner and detergent supports faster results. With a 6m high-pressure hose, 380 litres per hour flow rate and integrated accessory storage, it offers practical performance for regular domestic maintenance.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
